natural_language_instruction: Spawn in survival mode. Multi-step crafting chain: (1) gather wood and craft a crafting_table, (2) gather 8 cobblestone, craft a furnace, (3) acquire raw_iron (at least 1) and coal (at least 1) by mining, (4) place the furnace, smelt 1 raw_iron into 1 iron_ingot using coal as fuel, (5) end the run with at least 1 iron_ingot in inventory and the furnace still placed in the world. bot.health > 0.
success_criteria: a furnace block is placed in the world (within 32 blocks of bot final position)
a crafting_table block is placed in the world (within 32 blocks of bot final position)
